title: Olive Hoots for the Pals
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters sl, sm, sn, sp.

pages.brief: Olive the owl and several small animal friends walking together into an old wooden barn.
The inside of the barn growing dim and shadowy around the group.
Olive the owl looking around, unable to spot her friends in the dim barn.
Olive the owl hooting loudly, head tilted back.
Olive the owl hooting again and again into the shadows.
The small animal friends, partly hidden among hay bales, perking up at the sound.
The small animal friends making their way toward Olive through the dim barn.
Olive the owl looking relieved and pleased as her friends arrive.
Olive the owl and her friends sitting together in a cosy group inside the barn.
